needs_human.note: Non-processing intelligence events (refine, summaries, transcription, vision) now reach the browser when CORE_INTERNAL_SECRET is set; before this change they were dropped with 403.; refine, summaries, whisper and vision posts now use trust_env=False, so a proxy set through the environment is no longer used for the core call.; chapter_suggestions and video_visual now swallow every exception, not only httpx.HTTPError.

Unscoped intelligence events (vision_describe.*, and possibly others that do not set data['drive']) are now delivered to every connected viewer when CORE_INTERNAL_SECRET is set. Before this change they were presumably dropped with a 403.

Vision, refine, summaries and transcription events now pass the core's secret gate and are broadcast. Vision events without a drive go to every viewer.; chapter_suggestions and video_visual now swallow every exception, where before they caught only httpx.HTTPError.
